post.description: Retire one replica of a serving deployment. Default mode shrinks the fleet by one: the replica starts draining at once and is not replaced. replace=true swaps the replica without losing capacity, on any replica including the last one serving: a replacement is launched first, this replica keeps serving (replace_requested_at set) until the replacement serves, then it drains. Both boxes are billed during the overlap. If the replacement fails (crashes, misses its provisioning deadline, or finds no capacity) this replica keeps serving and GET .../replicas shows why in replace_error; it is not retried automatically. A draining replica finishes its in-flight requests before its box is terminated (bounded by the drain timeout); a replica still booting (queued/provisioning) is cancelled outright in either mode.

Swap mode: retire this replica WITHOUT shrinking the fleet or losing

LAST box dies after it has served (crash or host failure), 0..=5.
Replacements go out 0, 10, 20, 40 and 80s after the previous launch.
Used up (or 0): a min_replicas >= 1 deployment goes 'failed' with
failure_code `replica_lost`, a min_replicas = 0 one parks. Losing some
boxes of a multi-replica fleet is not governed by this. Omitted => 3.

cache.description:
HF cache-through (source=huggingface only): also save the downloaded
snapshot to the caller's model library so later deploys of this repo
start from S3 instead of the HF hub. Best-effort: a failed upload
never affects this deployment. Omitted => no caching.

vllm_extra_args.description:
Extra vLLM CLI flags appended verbatim to the engine command
(argv list, e.g. ["--speculative-config", "{...}", "--kv-cache-dtype",
"fp8"]). vllm engine only. Flags the platform owns (--model, --port,
--host, --api-key, --served-model-name) and --trust-remote-code are
rejected at create.

vllm_image.description:
Explicit vLLM serving image (e.g. "vllm/vllm-openai:v0.25.1")
for architectures newer than the platform default vLLM. Official
upstream images only (vllm/vllm-openai[-rocm]:<tag>). vllm engine only.
Forces the docker launcher on every provider, including AWS. Omitted =>
platform default.

startup_profiling.description:
Opt-in vLLM startup diagnostics: the serving agent exports
VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG + VLLM_GC_DEBUG=1 to the engine, records
startup phase timings, and reports them on the first healthy heartbeat
(or in the failure detail with a deeper stderr tail). Default false:
diagnostic logging slows inference, so use for diagnosis launches, not
steady customer traffic.

trace_bodies.description:
Request traces: capture this deployment's chat request/response bodies
and make them queryable via /v1/deployments/{id}/traces. Default false
(privacy: enabling stores end-user prompt/completion content, retained
per trace_retention). Requires the traces feature; billed per 1k traces
beyond the monthly free allowance.

trace_retention.description:
Trace retention class: omitted/null = "base" (14-day retention, base
rate), "extended" = 400-day retention at the extended rate. Only
meaningful with trace_bodies=true.

serving_mode.description:
"single" (default) or "multi_adapter": a fleet serving the base model
plus N hot-loaded LoRA adapters attached via
`/v1/deployments/{id}/adapters`.

max_loras.description:
vLLM --max-loras (GPU-resident adapter cap) for multi_adapter
deployments. Omitted => the default (32).

max_lora_rank.description:
vLLM --max-lora-rank for multi_adapter deployments. Omitted => the
default (64).

max_cpu_loras.description:
vLLM --max-cpu-loras (CPU-offload headroom) for multi_adapter
deployments. Omitted => the default (128).

gpu_utilization.description:
Mean GPU utilization percent (0-100) across replicas reporting
in the bucket; null when no replica reported GPU telemetry. Debugging
metric: scale on requests_waiting + kv_cache_usage.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory in use (bytes) across reporting replicas.

replica_id.description:
Set when the response is scoped to one replica (?replica_id=); absent
for deployment-wide scope.

total_requests.description: Lifetime count of your API requests (eval calls excluded).

total_prompt_tokens.description: Lifetime prompt tokens of your API requests (eval calls excluded).

total_completion_tokens.description: Lifetime completion tokens of your API requests (eval calls excluded).

total_cost_usd.description:
GPU cost accrued over the deployment's life: every replica of every
boot, from its launch to its termination (or now), at its per-box rate.
This is what billing charges, before rounding to the cent; the
deployment's own `total_cost_usd` is the part already settled.

uptime_seconds.description:
Seconds during which at least one GPU box was up and billed, summed over
every boot (wakes included, parked time excluded). Null until a box
launches.

cost_usd.description:
GPU cost billed inside this bucket: every replica's billed time (launch
to termination) that falls in the bucket, times its per-box rate. The
buckets sum to `cost_efficiency.cost_usd` (before cent rounding).

replica_id.description:
Set when the response is scoped to one replica (?replica_id=); absent
for deployment-wide scope.

gpu_utilization.description: This replica's latest GPU utilization percent in the bucket.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: This replica's latest GPU memory in use (bytes) in the bucket.

replica_id.description: `legacy` represents pre-replica samples recorded directly on a deployment.

DeploymentReplicaResponse.description:
A frontend-safe view of a serving replica. The endpoint itself remains
private to the control plane; the topology only needs to know whether an
endpoint is currently routable.

region.description:
Cloud region the box launched into; None when the provider path does
not expose it (pre-placement rows, non-AWS providers).

cost_per_box_hour_usd.description:
Per-box hourly rate: the rate snapshotted on the replica at launch,
else the deployment's per-box fallback.

gpu_utilization.description:
GPU hardware snapshot (NVML, from the last heartbeat). All
fields absent when the worker did not report telemetry. Debugging
metric only: scale on requests_waiting + kv_cache_usage, not this
(nvidia-smi-style utilization measures kernel residency, not pressure).
Mean utilization percent (0-100) across the replica's GPUs.

gpu_memory_used_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory in use across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_memory_total_bytes.description: Summed GPU memory capacity across the replica's GPUs, bytes.

gpu_power_w.description: Summed power draw across the replica's GPUs, watts.

gpu_temperature_c.description: Hottest GPU on the replica, degrees C.

gpu_devices.description: Per-GPU readings behind the aggregates above.

replace_requested_at.description:
Set while a `drain?replace=true` is in flight for this replica: it keeps
serving traffic until its replacement serves, then drains. Null when no
replace is in flight.

replaces_replica_id.description:
On a replacement box launched by `drain?replace=true`: the replica it
replaces. Cleared once it takes over; kept when it failed.

replace_error.description:
Why the last `drain?replace=true` of this replica failed (the
replacement crashed, did not become ready within its provisioning
deadline, or could not launch). The replica kept serving; it is not
retried automatically, so call the drain with replace=true again.

adapter_serve_name.description:
The adapter alias (serve_name) this request resolved through on a
multi_adapter deployment; null for base-model requests.

model_version_id.description:
The model version id that answered this request: the adapter alias'
version on a multi_adapter deployment, the base model's version for
base requests on a deployment built from a library model, null
otherwise.

thread_id.description:
The client-sent thread id (X-Veri-Thread-Id, alias X-Veri-Session-Id);
null when none was sent.

agent_name.description: The client-sent X-Veri-Agent header; null when none was sent.

tool_names.description: The tools whose results this request carries (one entry per call).

latency_ms.description: Backward-compatible alias for e2e_latency_ms on newly recorded requests.

source_model_id.description:
For a custom_model deployment, the saved model this was created from
(provenance). Also set on a source=huggingface deployment that took the
transparent cache hit (serving from the caller's cached S3 copy). Null
otherwise.

cache_model_id.description:
HF cache-through: the library model (status importing) this
deployment's box is uploading its snapshot into. Null unless the
deployment was created with cache=true and the upload is the one this
boot owns.

endpoint_url.description:
The URL to call once the deployment serves. Managed deployments
(aws, gcp, digitalocean) get the platform chat URL
`{api}/v1/deployments/{id}/chat/completions`, authenticated with your
Veri API key; BYOC (huggingface) deployments carry the endpoint URL
under your own HF account. Null until the deployment first serves, and
null while it is parked (scaled_to_zero) until a wake serves again; it
stays set after stop or failure.

byoc_repo.description:
BYOC (provider='huggingface'): the HF hub repository this endpoint
serves under the owner's account. Null for every non-BYOC deployment.

vllm_extra_args.description:
The extra vLLM CLI flags this deployment was created with
(argv list). Null unless supplied at create.

vllm_image.description:
The explicit vLLM serving image this deployment was created
with. Null unless supplied at create.

startup_profiling.description: Whether this deployment was created with startup diagnostics on.

trace_bodies.description: Whether request/response bodies are captured as traces.

trace_retention.description:
Trace retention class ("extended" or null = base). Null unless
trace_bodies deployments set it.

startup_metrics.description:
Startup phase timings reported by a profiled deployment's first healthy
heartbeat (seconds: model_sync_s, engine_start_to_healthy_s, total_s).
Null unless startup_profiling was set and the engine reached healthy.

num_replicas.description:
Desired replica count (GPU boxes) behind this deployment. The
observed count is ready_replicas; the CLI renders "ready/desired"
(e.g. 2/3).

ready_replicas.description: Observed: replicas currently serving with a routable endpoint.

min_replicas.description: Replica-count bounds. min == max => fixed N (autoscaling off).

scale_to_zero_window_seconds.description: Idle window before a min=0 deployment parks (None = 3600s).

idle_delete_after_days.description:
Days a parked deployment is kept before it is stopped (None = kept
forever).

self_heal_attempts.description:
How many times Veri replaces the GPU box when the deployment's
last box dies after it has served, 0..=5 (default 3).

failure_code.description:
Machine-readable reason for the last failure, e.g. `watchdog_timeout`,
`CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE`, `replica_lost` (the last GPU box was lost
after serving: while 'provisioning' Veri is replacing it, with
'failed' or 'scaled_to_zero' self_heal_attempts was used up or 0), or
the serving agent's `oom` / `model_source_unsupported`. Null when no
failure is recorded; cleared with `error` on an idle park and on wake.
A failed wake re-parks with its code (e.g. `wake_boot_failed`).

last_wake_at.description:
When the most recent wake of this scale-to-zero deployment started: a
chat request to the parked deployment, `POST /wake`, or a PATCH that
left a parked deployment with `min_replicas` >= 1. Kept after the
wake serves or the deployment parks again. Null if it never woke.

wake_failure_count.description:
Consecutive failed wake boots since the deployment last reached
serving (0 when the last boot served). A failed wake re-parks the
deployment (`scaled_to_zero`, still wakeable) and adds 1; reaching
serving resets it to 0. Starting a new wake does not reset it.

next_wake_not_before.description:
After a failed wake: the earliest time a chat request triggers the
next wake (backoff of 60s doubling per consecutive failure, up to 1h).
`POST /wake` and a PATCH that raises `min_replicas` to 1 or more
bypass it. Null until a wake fails; cleared when a wake reaches
serving. A time in the past means the backoff has elapsed.

DeploymentUpdate.description:
PATCH /v1/deployments/{id}: the mutable-field whitelist. Everything else on
a deployment (model, source, gpu, engine, provider) is immutable: changing
those means creating a new deployment. Sending an immutable field in a
PATCH is a validation error instead of a silent no-op.

Desired-state semantics: the PATCH validates + persists the new bounds and
returns immediately (desired + observed); the reconciler's scaling pass
converges the replica fleet asynchronously. A scaled_to_zero deployment
left with min_replicas >= 1 is woken by the PATCH itself (cap-checked);
during a first boot the new bounds apply once the deployment serves.
An omitted field keeps its stored value; only scale_to_zero_window_seconds
and idle_delete_after_days read an explicit null as "clear".

scale_to_zero_window_seconds.description:
Idle seconds before a min_replicas = 0 deployment parks (minimum 300).
Omit to keep the current value; null clears it back to the default
(3600). Changing or clearing it while scale-to-zero is on starts a
fresh idle window.

idle_delete_after_days.description:
Days a deployment may stay parked with no traffic before it is
auto-stopped (minimum 1). Omit to keep the current value; null clears
it (never auto-stop).

self_heal_attempts.description:
Replacements of a lost last GPU box, 0..=5. Any PATCH also
restarts the replacement budget.

DepsSpec.description:
Dependency layer for a custom_script job. The worker installs these inside the
container before the entrypoint (uv pip). `kind` is "requirements" | "uv_lock"
| "none"; `content` is the file text for the first two.

version.description: The latest version unless `?version=` asked for another.

EnvironmentSpecInput.description:
The environment spec as submitted. Also the body of
`POST /v1/environments/{id}/versions`.

model.description: Where the harness sends model calls.

allowed_hosts.description: Extra hostnames a restricted session may reach.

env.description: Plain environment variables for the harness.

secrets.description:
Secret names injected as environment variables named after them
(or attached per host when the secret has a scope_host).

idle_timeout_s.description:
Seconds without input before the session snapshots and pauses
(60 .. 21600, default 900).

spec.description: The normalized spec: defaults filled, hosts lowercased, skills pinned.

name.description:
1-64 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Also the Langfuse
score name.

output_config.description:
See EvaluatorVersionResponse.output_config. Optional for boolean
(pass_when defaults to true).

method_config.description:
See EvaluatorVersionResponse.method_config. `runtime: cloud` requires
javascript or typescript.

EvaluatorPin.description: One pinned evaluator version, stored in `experiments.evaluators`.

judge_model.description: llm_judge: the judge deployment's served model id at create.

name.description: Unique per workspace; usable in place of the id in every path.

archived_at.description: Set when archived: no new versions; hidden from the default list.

version.description: The latest version, or the one asked for with `?version=N`.

versions.description: Version history, oldest first. Only on GET /v1/evaluators/{id_or_name}.

EvaluatorVersionCreateRequest.description:
A new version. Omitted fields are copied from the latest version, so an
edit sends only what changes (e.g. just `method_config` for a new prompt).

output_config.description:
Normalized output config (defaults filled in): boolean {pass_when},
categorical {labels, pass_labels}, numeric {min, max, pass_threshold,
higher_is_better}.

method_config.description:
llm_judge {prompt, judge: {deployment_id, model}, mode}, code
{language, source, runtime}, human {instructions}, jev {model,
question: {type, instructions, criteria}, state, threshold}.
llm_judge `mode`: `reasoned` (default, omitted) writes a reasoned
verdict; `decision` answers with exactly one label and a confidence
(boolean, categorical, or numeric with integer min/max at most 10
apart). jev (TypeSafe's Jev): `question.type` noul (boolean, yes at
P(yes) >= `threshold`, default 0.5), choice (categorical, `criteria`
= {option: description}, 2-255 options) or score (numeric 0..N-1,
`criteria` = N ordered level descriptions, 2-10); `state` maps field
names to JSONPaths into the item (default {input, output}, or
{transcript} for threads).

EvaluatorVersionSummary.description: A version in an evaluator's history.

dataset.description:
Dataset id or name, optionally `@snap-N` or `@latest`. A stream with
no suffix pins `@latest` (reusing the newest snapshot when it is at
the head, else cutting one).

target.description:
`{kind: "deployment", deployment_id, model?}` |
`{kind: "model_version", model_version_id}` | `{kind: "none"}` (score
each row's recorded output).

evaluators.description:
Evaluator ids or names, each optionally `@N` (default: the latest
version). llm_judge and code evaluators only.

bindings.description: Variable name -> JSONPath, layered over every evaluator's bindings.

baseline_experiment_id.description:
A previous experiment to diff against at completion (comparable only
on the same snapshot with identical evaluator pins).

ExperimentItemInfo.description: An experiment item as a reviewer sees it.

turn.description: The turn under review (per-turn items of a replayed thread).

status.description: pending | running | done | error

ExperimentItemResponse.description: One (row, trial) with its output and scores.

turns.description: Thread items: the user turns replayed.

status.description: pending | running | done | error

output.description: The target's answer (the last one, for a thread).

transcript.description: The conversation, when the item has one.

request_ids.description: The deployment requests this item made.

pending_local.description:
Only with `?pending_local=true`: the local code scores this item
still owes, each with the args to run the evaluator on.

status.description: queued | running | awaiting_local | completed | failed | canceled

dataset_snapshot_id.description: The snapshot the run is pinned to (`<dataset_id>@snap-N`).

target_deployment_id.description:
Resolved at create: the deployment called, the request `model` sent
(an adapter's versioned internal name for a model version on a
fleet), the model version, and the served model's identity.

evaluators.description: The pinned evaluator versions (+ each judge's served model).

items_total.description: Items = rows x trials; done counts finished items (ok or error).

aggregates.description:
Per evaluator at completion: n, ok, errors, skipped, pass_rate (all
items in the denominator), mean, label_counts, critical_failures.

passed.description:
Every evaluator with a pass rule passed every item with no errors;
null until completed, or when no evaluator has a pass rule.

diff.description: The diff against the baseline, computed at completion.

FromScoresRequest.description:
Add the targets of the workspace's ok scores from one evaluator that
match every given filter, newest score first.

min.description: Numeric scores only: value >= min / value <= max.

deployment_id.description: Trace and thread queues: one deployment's traffic.

from.description: Scores created at or after / before (RFC 3339).

GateConfig.description: What promotion evidence must look like (`models.gate_config`).

dataset_snapshot_id.description: The snapshot the evidence ran on (`<dataset_id>@snap-N`).

evaluators.description: The exact evaluator versions the evidence was scored by.

thresholds.description:
evaluator_id -> minimum pass rate in [0, 1] (all items in the
denominator). Pinned evaluators with a pass rule and no entry need 1.0.

trials.description: The evidence ran at least this many trials per row.

max_error_rate.description: Maximum errors / items per evaluator, in [0, 1].

non_regression.description:
Also require no evaluator to be worse than the current production
version's run on the same snapshot and pins.

regression_tolerance.description:
How much worse (pass-rate points in [0, 1]; for a numeric evaluator
without a pass rule, that fraction of its range) still counts as no
regression.

GatePatch.description:
PATCH /v1/models/{name}/gate: every field optional; a present field
replaces the stored one.

enabled.description:
true turns the gate on (needs a snapshot and at least one evaluator);
false turns it off and keeps the config.

evaluators.description: llm_judge and code evaluators (human evaluators can't gate).

thresholds.description:
Pinned evaluator (id or name) -> minimum pass rate in [0, 1]. Only
evaluators with a pass rule. Replaces the whole map.

GatePin.description: One evaluator version the gate pins.

GatePinInput.description:
One evaluator version to pin: `evaluator_id` is an id or a name in the
workspace; `version` defaults to the latest.

Generation.description: Sampling params for the target's calls. Omitted = the server default.

GpuAvailabilityRow.description:
One availability row. Mirrors the transport `AvailabilityRow` JSON (SA-3); the
control plane passes it through verbatim. Optional fields are provider-shaped,
so `serde(default)` lets a row the transport omitted a field on still parse.

gpu_count.description:
GPUs per launchable unit (Vast smallest chunk / DO droplet cards; AWS
whole-node GPU count).

status.description:
"AVAILABLE" (live count > 0), "OFFERED" (AWS catalog + spot proxy),
or "UNAVAILABLE".

available.description: Live count (Vast matching offers / DO per-region signal; absent for AWS).

spot_score.description: AWS Spot placement score 1–10 proxy (absent for other providers).

price_per_hr.description:
Per-GPU USD/hr for this shape. On the wire from the transport this is the
provider's RAW published rate; before returning to the caller the endpoint
marks it up by the per-provider markup so it matches the customer
price on /v1/cost/rates and never leaks the raw margin.

checked_at.description:
When the returned rows were probed. Null only when no snapshot exists
yet AND a refresh is already in flight (retry shortly).

age_seconds.description: Seconds since `checked_at` (server clock), for staleness at a glance.

refreshed.description:
True when THIS request ran the probe (cache was stale and the lock was
free). False = served from cache.

refreshing.description:
True when another request's probe is in flight; the rows below are the
previous snapshot. Poll again in a few seconds for the fresh one.

GpuCatalogRow.description: One catalog row: a (provider, workload, gpu_type) offering.

node_counts.description:
Orderable GPUs-per-node counts for this shape (e.g. [8] for AWS
A100/H100, whole nodes only; [1, 8] for DigitalOcean H100 training).

status.description:
"available" (orderable now) or "coming_soon" (wired but behind a
feature flag; a create 400s until the flag flips).

usd_per_gpu_hr.description:
Customer $/GPU-hr (marked up, matching /v1/cost/rates). Absent until
the provider's rate is seeded; never a fabricated 0.

GpuDeviceMetrics.description:
One GPU's NVML reading from the replica's last heartbeat. Every
field except `index` is individually best-effort (some GPUs/VMs withhold
power or temperature).

utilization.description:
Utilization percent (0-100) as NVML reports it: the share of time a
kernel was resident, not how much of the chip it used.

GpuInfo.description:
Pydantic `GPUInfo` (with `type` field). Rust uses `gpu_type` internally
but serializes as "type" for JSON parity.

max_prompt_length.description:
Only applies with use_unsloth (it sizes the context window with
max_response_length); without it a submit that sets it is a 400.

global_batch_size.description:
Not supported by GRPO: a submit that sets it is a 400. Echoed only for
a job stored with it before that check.

harness_protocol.description:
Which protocol the harness speaks: "openai" (OpenAI SDK / LangChain /
OpenAI Agents SDK) or "anthropic" (Claude Agent SDK).

max_turns.description:
Turn budget hint passed to the harness (VERI_MAX_TURNS). Higher than
grpo_agentic's 5: agent SDKs chain many tool calls per task.

harness_timeout_s.description: Wall-clock budget for ONE harness invocation (one rollout).

max_parallel_rollouts.description: Concurrent harness invocations per training step.

vllm_gpu_memory_utilization.description:
vLLM memory fraction for the colocated policy server; the rest stays
free for training. Lower than a serving deployment's 0.9 by design.

trajectory_retention_days.description:
Days raw trajectories stay in S3 before the retention sweep removes
them (the Postgres index rows are deleted too). None = keep forever.

HarnessGrpoHyperparameters.description:
Harness-in-the-loop GRPO: the user's own agent harness (Claude
Agent SDK / LangChain / OpenAI Agents SDK) drives multi-turn rollouts
against the in-training policy. Shares GRPO's core knobs; the
harness-specific ones tune rollout execution and the colocated vLLM
policy server. The harness code itself arrives via the job's `script`
payload (same shape as custom_script).

HeadlineMetric.description:
The headline number on a card: the run's primary metric, latest value and
its change since the first logged step. `reward` when the run logs it
(RL methods), else `loss`.

repo.description:
Target repo as "namespace/name". Created on first push (honoring
`private`); re-exports to an existing repo upload over it.

private.description:
Repo visibility. Defaults to private: a public push is an explicit
choice, never an accident.

status.description: launching | uploading | completed | failed | cancelled

hf_repo_url.description: Set on completion; the pushed repo's URL.

HfPushConfig.description:
Opt-in end-of-training push of the trained artifact to the user's Hugging
Face account. Requires a connected HF integration
(PUT /v1/settings/integrations/huggingface); the token itself never rides
in the job config; the worker exchanges its callback_token for it at
runtime, exactly like W&B.

artifact.description:
Which artifact to push: "merged" (full standalone weights) or
"adapter" (LoRA adapter only; requires lora_rank on the job).

private.description:
Repo visibility. Defaults to private: a public push is an explicit
choice, never an accident.

token.description:
Hugging Face access token (huggingface.co/settings/tokens) with write
scope. Stored encrypted at rest; never returned by the API.

username.description: The HF account the token belongs to (from whoami at connect time).

HumanAgreement.description:
Agreement between a monitor's verdicts and human labels of the same
evaluator on the same targets.

n.description: Targets with both a monitor verdict and a human verdict.

rate.description: Share of them where the verdicts agree, 0..1.

ItemTarget.description:
One target, shaped by the queue's target_type: trace {request_id};
thread {deployment_id, thread_id, target_revision?} (default: the
thread's latest request, pinned when added); experiment_item
{experiment_id, item_id}. Fields of other target types are refused.

ItemsAddRequest.description:
Exactly one of `targets` (1-1000, all checked, all or nothing) or
`from_scores`.

already_present.description: Targets already in the queue (or repeated in the request).

skipped.description:
from_scores only: matching targets that no longer resolve (e.g. a
purged request) or don't fit the queue's evaluators.

counts.description: The queue's counts after the add.

attribution.description:
Who the failure belongs to: "platform" (credited), "customer", or
"pending" (under review). Absent on jobs that failed before this field existed.

source.description: The reward function source exactly as submitted.

JudgeHumanAgreement.description: How often an llm_judge agrees with human scores on the same targets.

version.description: The pinned version whose (non-human) scores are compared.

count.description:
Targets with both a non-human score of the pinned version and a
human score of the same evaluator (any version), both with a verdict.

agreement.description: The fraction of those targets whose `passed` agrees; null when none.

warning.description: Set when count >= 10 and agreement < 0.8. Never blocks a promotion.

content.description: The reply text; null without a stored body for this call.

name.description:
Short identifier, `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`; becomes the server key in
the harness's MCP config.

url.description: HTTPS URL of a streamable-HTTP MCP server.

secret.description: Optional secret name sent as `Authorization: Bearer <value>`.

email.description:
Display email, synced from the signed-in session when a key was minted.
Null until the user mints a key through the web proxy.

plan.description: Reserved for future billing plan surfacing.

org_id.description:
The active workspace when the caller is scoped to a team workspace
(workspaces design); null for personal scope. The field predates
workspaces (reserved as "org_id"), so the name stays for SDK
compatibility. Prefer `workspace`.

workspace.description:
The active workspace: the billing entity every call and
charge is scoped to. Personal: id == user id, kind "personal".

ModelAliasResponse.description: An alias of a lineage and the version it points at.

version.description: The version number the alias resolves to.

download_url.description:
Presigned URL of the primary weights file. Legacy single-file field:
an HF checkpoint is a directory, so downloading only this yields an
unloadable model; use `files` instead.

files.description:

passed.description:
The evaluator version's pass rule applied to the value; null when the
version has no pass rule or the score carries no value.

status.description: ok | error | skipped

error.description: Why an error / skipped score has no value.

author.description: The user who wrote the score.

model_version_id.description: The model version that answered the scored request, when known.

monitor_id.description: The monitor that wrote the score (source monitor).

confidence.description:
The judge's probability for its verdict, 0..1; null unless a
decision-mode judge wrote the score.

probabilities.description:
The Jev judge's distribution behind the value: noul
`{"true": p, "false": 1 - p}`, choice `{option: p}`, score
`{"<level>": p}`. Null for every other score.

conversations.description: Conversations that started in this bucket (each counted once).

environment_version.description: Pin a specific environment version (default: latest).

budget_usd.description:
Spend ceiling for this session in USD. The session pauses when its
accrued cost reaches it.

payload_ref.description: Object-storage key when the payload exceeded the inline cap.

status.description: provisioning | ready | running | paused | ended | failed

awake_seconds.description: Seconds the sandbox has been awake (what the session meter bills).

name.description: `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}`. Reusing a name creates the next version.

description.description: One line the harness uses to decide when the skill applies.

instructions.description: The SKILL.md body (Markdown). At most 256 KiB.

allowed_tools.description: Advisory tool allowlist written into the skill's frontmatter.

note.description: Why the item was skipped (at most 8 KB).

added.description:
Data rows appended in (from_head, to_head] (supersede rows included:
they are new rows too).

name.description: Short reference ("snap-<seq>") accepted wherever a snapshot is named.

Span.description: One timeline segment: a model call or the tool work between two calls.

oneOf.description:
A deployment in the workspace. `model` addresses an adapter
serve_name on a multi-adapter fleet (default: the deployment itself).

A model version: the exact weights, on the fleet adapter or the
single-model deployment that serves them.
No calls: every row's recorded output is scored.

TargetSpec.description: What the experiment runs against, as requested.

status.description: active | idle

bodies.description:
captured (the newest call's body is stored) | partial (an older
call's is) | none (no stored bodies: trace bodies off or purged).

tools.description: The `tools` the agent declared, from the stored body.

turns.description: The latest 1000 model calls, oldest first, grouped into turns.

scores.description: Thread and trace scores on this thread, newest first.

messages.description: Transcript messages (counted from the steps without a stored body).

row_id.description: The row to hide from every snapshot cut from here on.

arguments.description: The call's JSON arguments, as the model wrote them.

ToolStep.description: One tool call the agent ran between two model calls.

duration_ms.description: Next model call start minus this call's completion.

from.description: Start of the trace window. Required unless `thread_id` is set.

to.description:
End of the trace window, at most 31 days after `from`. Required
unless `thread_id` is set.

oneOf.description:
Row format to write; defaults to the dataset's locked format.
v1 accepts `chat` and `prompt` only.

Keep only traces with an ok score from `evaluator` matching `passed` /
`min` / `max` (e.g. the judge's failures). Window imports only.

thread_id.description:
Import one thread of `deployment` as one row, built from its newest
stored trace (whose messages hold the whole conversation).
`from`/`to`/`limit`/`force`/`model_version_id` do not apply.

skipped.description:
Per-reason counts of traces that were fetched but not written,
e.g. {"no_choices": 3, "filtered_version": 28}.

TraceScoreFilter.description: Score filter for a window import (see `scores`).

evaluator.description: Evaluator id or name in the caller's workspace.

evaluator_version.description: Only scores from this evaluator version; omitted matches any version.

passed.description: Only scores whose pass/fail verdict equals this.

min.description: Numeric scores only: value >= min / value <= max.

label.description:
VS-486 (400 while VERI_FEATURE_JEV is off): a categorical label, or
`true` / `false` for a boolean score.

dataset_id.description:
Dataset reference: a dataset id or name, optionally pinned to a
snapshot: `ds_…@snap-3` trains on that snapshot, `ds_…@latest` cuts
(or reuses) a snapshot at the current head and pins it. A plain
reference to a stream dataset behaves like `@latest`; a plain
reference to a one-shot upload trains on it as before.

reward_source.description:
Inline reward source (Python text, TRL signature). Attached to the job
at submit and stored job-scoped; there is no stored reward resource.

oneOf.description:
Where the checkpoint is stored: omit it or send {"type": "veri"}.
Checkpoints are always stored in Veri storage; another type (s3, gs,
az), a uri or credentials is rejected with a 400.

Push the trained artifact to your Hugging Face account when the job
completes. Requires a connected HF integration
(PUT /v1/settings/integrations/huggingface). Validated at submit:
managed grpo/grpo_harness/sft_text/dpo jobs only, and
artifact="adapter" needs hyperparameters.lora_rank. On success the job
carries hf_repo_url.

volume.description:
Not available yet: volume-backed training is not implemented, so a
non-blank volume is rejected with a 400. Pass the data as dataset_id.

dataset_snapshot_id.description:
The dataset snapshot this job was pinned to at submit
("<dataset_id>@snap-N"); set when dataset_id was given as `…@snap-N`
or `…@latest` (or names a stream dataset). Null for legacy submits.

reward_count.description:
How many inline reward sources the job was submitted with (null for
reward-free methods). Sources are viewable per job via the dashboard.

hyperparameters.description:
The resolved hyperparameters, defaults filled in. The shape depends on
`method`: GrpoHyperparameters (grpo), AgenticGrpoHyperparameters
(grpo_agentic), HarnessGrpoHyperparameters (grpo_harness),
SftTextHyperparameters (sft_text), DpoHyperparameters (dpo),
SftVideoGenHyperparameters (sft_video_gen). Null for custom_script
jobs.

resolved_parallelism.description:
The multi-GPU launch plan the worker resolved (dp, zero_stage, micro_batch_size,
gradient_accumulation_steps, global_batch_size, precision, ...). Null for
single-GPU jobs and before the worker has planned.

oneOf.description: Credit state for a platform-attributed failure; null when not applicable.
The hf_push request echoed back (null when the job didn't opt in).

hf_repo_url.description:
Set after a successful end-of-training push to Hugging Face; the
pushed repo's URL (mirrors wandb_run_url).

visibility.description:
Public-run state (Explore): `private` (default), `public`, or
`admin_hidden` (removed by Veri; cannot be re-published).

enabled.description:
true re-enables an auto-disabled endpoint (clears disabled_at and the
consecutive-failure counter); false disables it.

api_key.description:
W&B API key (from wandb.ai/authorize). Stored encrypted at rest; never
returned by the API.

project.description: Default W&B project training runs log to. Defaults to "veri-training".

secret.description:
Full "whsec_..." signing secret on create ONLY; masked on every other
read (use GET /v1/webhooks/{id}/secret to retrieve it again).

event_types.description: Empty = subscribed to all event types.

disabled_at.description:
Set when the endpoint is disabled (manually or automatically after 50
consecutive delivery failures). Disabled endpoints receive no events.

event_id.description: The webhook.test event id; arrives as the webhook-id header.

model_retention_days.description: 0..=3650. 0 = purge eligible items on the next nightly sweep.

Days unprotected model versions and unreferenced dataset snapshots are
kept (default 90; 0 = zero-data-retention opt-in).

third_party_judges.description:
Evaluators may send trace text to a third-party judge (TypeSafe's
Jev). Off: jev evaluators can't be created and queued Jev work is
skipped.

updated_at.description: Null until the workspace changes a default.

ZeroStage.description:
ZeRO sharding stage: "auto" (data parallel when the model states fit one GPU,
otherwise stage 3), or an explicit 0, 2 or 3.

bearerAuth.description: API key with the `vk_` prefix. Create one from the dashboard.
